scope: 1,000 more MythicSim Forever Quick Sims from 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-20, every class, each seeded from its sim id, at the c7c423bd7 pin
generator: prepared_v2.py compare over production report requests
rerun: The requests are MythicSim user sims and are not published; rerun with python3 tools/prepared_v2.py compare --output <scratch> <requests>

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Sim ids are replaced by an index; each request kept its own seed, derived from its sim id.

At fc428f0 one Survival Hunter differed (Rust +0.44%): its rotation casts Aspect of the Beast over the prepull Aspect of the Hawk, and Rust kept both up because it only tracked the single aura Aspect category. The Hunter agent now enforces it; the request is accepted as survival-hunter-aspect-of-the-beast-over-hawk and its row here is the rerun.

The 56 errors are the pinned Go exporter refusing requests made before the 16 October talent trees (client 70425): Mage and Priest talent strings with ranks or talents the current trees lack. Go cannot run them at this pin either.

The 50 rejections fall back to Go: mostly Protection Warrior Shield Block (2565) and other unknown rotation spells, prepull actions outside the rotation, comma decimal constants, item swaps the runtime does not follow, currentHealthPercent sourceUnit, and set bonus listeners (Deathbone Guardian, Stormshroud Armor).
